claim: Several sleep or circadian phenotypes have nonzero genome-wide genetic correlations with the registered Frailty Index.
evidence_basis: frailty_paper/analysis/frozen_atlas_frailty_global_rg.tsv; inherited q-values from the frozen 396-pair atlas family; nine of 12 have q≤0.05
key_limitations: Reuses frozen atlas estimates rather than full raw-input replay; European-ancestry source; UK Biobank participation and exact overlap are unresolved; one endpoint definition only
manuscript_action: Report as global genetic correlation with the FI; retain frozen-family q-values and source/overlap caveats

claim: The FI pair estimates agree across the frozen atlas and separate frailty_v1 LDSC workflow to floating-point precision.
evidence_basis: frailty_paper/analysis/frozen_atlas_frailty_global_rg.tsv and frailty_paper/results/frailty_v1/global_rg_sleep_frailty.tsv; 11 values numerically identical and one differs only by decimal serialization (relative difference 1.72e-16)
key_limitations: Same underlying GWAS sources and analysis family; this is workflow concordance, not cohort replication
manuscript_action: Call this a same-source workflow check, never independent replication

claim: Sleep traits have genome-wide correlations with the general and specific latent frailty factors.
key_limitations: Latent GWAS include UK Biobank; exact participant intersections are unknown; insomnia is an input indicator of the general factor, making insomnia–general rg part-whole dependent; no direct test compares factor estimates
manuscript_action: Describe as secondary sensitivity evidence; explicitly flag the insomnia–general-factor construct overlap; do not treat it as independent validation, rank factors or claim one dimension drives FI overlap

claim: Selected sleep traits show genome-wide correlations with selected aging-context traits in the frozen atlas.
evidence_basis: frailty_paper/analysis/frozen_atlas_aging_context_global_rg.tsv; original all-396 q-values retained, 26 of 72 q≤0.05
key_limitations: Read-only reuse of the same frozen atlas; not a new analysis, frailty endpoint, or independent replication
manuscript_action: Keep explicitly contextual and phenotype-specific; avoid causal interpretation

claim: The sleep–FI association is independently replicated.
evidence_basis: frailty_paper/analysis/replication_resource_audit.md; no eligible independent pairwise dataset/results established
key_limitations: Existing source audits do not provide an independent paired sleep and frailty estimate
manuscript_action: Do not claim replication; state that it has not been established

claim: Particular physical frailty components explain or drive sleep–frailty genetic overlap.
scope: Weight loss, exhaustion, activity, walking speed, grip strength
evidence_basis: frailty_paper/manifests/physical_component_qc.tsv and its checksum manifest; frailty_paper/analysis/physical_component_candidate_source_audit_2026-09-23.md; all five files pass recorded structural and duplicate-key checks, but build/ancestry/effect mapping/generating-study provenance remain unresolved
key_limitations: No eligible component sleep-pair estimates; structural QC does not make the files eligible for harmonization or establish a valid signed-effect model

claim: The FI findings generalize across FI, Fried phenotype, and HFRS definitions.
evidence_basis: frailty_paper/analysis/fried_ffs_acquisition_audit_2026-09-26.md; HFRS access/endpoint audits including `frailty_paper/analysis/hfrs_r12_public_manifest_recheck_2026-09-24.md` and `frailty_paper/analysis/hfrs_df13_release_route_recheck_2026-09-24.md`; no eligible alternative-definition pairwise results
key_limitations: FFS file acquired 2026-09-26, but exact-release build/effect conventions remain unresolved and it is not analyzed; HFRS endpoint/file not verified; physical component inputs ineligible
manuscript_action: Limit current primary inference to the registered FI and label latent factors separately

claim: Sleep and frailty share regional genetic architecture or loci.
evidence_basis: frailty_paper/config/lava_frailty_sensitivity_v1.yaml; frailty_paper/analysis/lava_full_receipt_integrity_2026-09-26_2307_checkpoint.json: 18,234/29,940 receipts validated; all 12 trait-level failure lower bounds exceed the frozen 1% allowance.
key_limitations: The complete scheduled family remains in progress; 11,706 slots had no validated receipt at scan end; 18,234 receipts were validated while inventory reached 18,237 and runner state reported 18,237. Current partial-family failure lower bounds fail every locked trait gate. Exact cohort overlap remains unknown. Failed gates prohibit local inference but do not establish absence of local sharing.
manuscript_action: Make no local-sharing, shared-locus, or variant claim. Continue the unchanged run for receipt completeness and final collation; retain no local inference under the failed gates.

claim: A specific variant, gene, protein, tissue, or cell type mediates the sleep–frailty relationship.
scope: Fine-mapping, trait-trait coloc, QTL and cell-type analyses
evidence_basis: No frailty-specific shared loci, fine-mapping, coloc, or locus-matched molecular/cellular results are present
key_limitations: No upstream eligible loci or matched molecular evidence; even future colocalization/QTL evidence would not alone establish mediation
manuscript_action: Make no gene, tissue, cell-type, or mediation claim

claim: Sleep causally affects frailty, or frailty causally affects sleep.
evidence_basis: Global LDSC genetic correlation results only; manuscript cites the method limitation and does not report an eligible causal analysis
key_limitations: Correlation does not establish causal direction; no adequate causal analysis is available

claim: The systematic review establishes the observational evidence base linking sleep and frailty.
evidence_basis: frailty_paper/review/pipeline_audit_2026-09-23.md; frailty_paper/analysis/review_screening_validation_2026-09-26_0310.log verifies 56,117 title/abstract records with 0 decisions and no full-text records; frailty_paper/review/manual_exports/README.md documents that no Embase, Scopus, Web of Science or PsycINFO exports were supplied. The 2026-09-19 prospective CHARLS study remains a post-snapshot record outside the frozen queue (frailty_paper/review/supplemental_post_snapshot_records.tsv and frailty_paper/analysis/post_snapshot_record_audit_2026-09-24.md); PMID/indexing status is unresolved and no screening decision or review count change is recorded.
key_limitations: No screened or included study set, no completed dual-review process, and no eligible risk-of-bias appraisal set; licensed database exports are absent. The post-snapshot record has not been incorporated or screened.
manuscript_action: Describe the current material as a PubMed search snapshot/evidence-map workflow only; do not call it a completed systematic review or synthesis.

claim: This is the first genetic study of sleep and frailty.
evidence_basis: frailty_paper/analysis/prior_genetic_sleep_frailty_audit.md; eight directly relevant studies in frozen PubMed corpus plus Huang et al. (2026) targeted follow-up
key_limitations: Prior sleep–frailty LDSC rg and MR findings exist; exact independence/overlap remains unresolved for several datasets
manuscript_action: Do not claim first sleep–frailty genetic evidence or first sleep-duration/napping FI rg; distinguish MR from LDSC
